HYPOTHESIS.finding: 'Cross-field concept collisions yield computable reasoning criteria at a rate above a random-triple baseline' was never put to a controlled test: no non-Nous or random-triple input was ever forged under a fixed judge, and the only external outcome (forge status) is dominated by the forge calendar. Neither the hypothesis nor its negation ('exhaust') is supported by the record.

DESIGN.finding: The design cannot answer its own question: (a) the selection score is the generating model's self-rating of its own completion, averaged over the three dimensions the README itself reports as non-predictive of forge (weight 0.000) while excluding the one it reports as predictive (implementability); (b) no control arm; (c) the prompt was changed mid-series (theorist -> engineer, commit da42cc7e0) and the shipped README kept the v1-regime yield claim. Load-bearing: the '20-30% warrant forging' and 'high-potential' framing that later dossiers inherited comes from (a)+(c).

IMPLEMENTATION.finding: The code does what the design says: scorer replay reproduces 5918/5918 stored scores from stored text; rating parse failures are 1.5% overall and concentrated in the 800-max_tokens run (79/87), fixed by max_tokens 2048 and rescore.py; the Coeus-weight loader, cross-field sampler, checkpointing and priority-triple injection are exercised paths (priority triples appear in the forge ledger on 03-31).

CONFIGURATION.finding: manifest.yaml default_model is qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b and the README advertises a 397B model, but 5915/5918 entries were produced by nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b (unlimited=true runs); Nous reads its key from agents/nous/.env or the environment (no keys.py), and the resume doc records the key as the revival blocker. Not load-bearing: the model/README mismatch does not change any historical verdict (no verdict was ever conditioned on the model), and the key blocker post-dates the last run.

EXECUTION.finding: Nous ran: 12 runs with data over 2026-03-24..03-28 (5918 entries; runs of 0.1-53.6 h), plus evidenced uncommitted output through 2026-04-02 (1212 ledger orphans incl. 9 priority triples) and descendants to 04-04. One run dir (20260325_132516) has meta only, started 36 s before 20260325_132552 -- an aborted start, not a failure of the capability. Second channel: the Keeper's capture of agora.intelligence_outputs (M1 canonical store, 15502 rows) holds 0 Nous rows and no Nous heartbeat; consistent with Nous never running on an Agora-instrumented template (its Agora/heartbeat surface was added 2026-05-13, after the last run) rather than with non-execution.

INSTRUMENTATION.finding: No run log, no token/cost accounting, no STATUS/Agora emission until 2026-05-13 (after the last run; never exercised -- 0 Nous rows in agora.intelligence_outputs per the Keeper capture), and the 03-31..04-02 output was never committed, so the record of what ran is the forge's ledger rather than Nous's own. The 800-token truncation made 87/87 ratings unparseable in run 115258 before rescore. Not load-bearing: the historical verdicts were not derived from these gaps (they were derived from the resume doc's lower-bound date and unread code).

MEASUREMENT.finding: The measurement carries its answer: the composite is the LLM's self-rating; its apparent forge signal (pooled AUC 0.755) is the forge calendar crossed with the prompt switch, and vanishes within forge day (0.519, p=0.12; 03-25: high_potential 56.6% vs 60.9% for the rest). The score distribution moved from 41.8% high_potential to 0.84% when the prompt changed with the model held fixed: the score measures the prompt. Load-bearing: every downstream reading of Nous 'quality' (README yield claim, Coeus weights, forge priority) rests on this score.

INTERPRETATION.finding: Later readers turned an input dependency and a launch pairing into a 'zombie gate', a lower-bound date into 'stopped', an unread generator into 'exhaust', and a superseded lineage into a stall; the README turned a v1-prompt yield into a standing claim; the 2026-06 dossiers state that the code was not read. Provenance: no autopsy row, no run log, uncommitted output, README/model/field mismatches.

ECOSYSTEM.finding: Nous had exactly one coded consumer (the forge) and one feedback producer (Coeus, itself found to have learned the forge calendar); within six days the pipeline forked to nous_t2/nous_t3 and the March forge lineage was abandoned, the M4 daemon shelved, and the key later lapsed. The shelving is an ecosystem event: nothing in the record shows Nous failing on its own terms before it was superseded. Load-bearing for the recorded 'shelved/LIMBO' status; not the primary cause of the missing fair test.

fair_test.scope: All committed runs (2026-03-24..03-28) and the forge windows that consumed them (03-24..04-02, 05-16..05-28).
fair_test.finding: The capability 'select concept triples that yield computable reasoning criteria' was never fairly exercised: the selection score is a self-rating with no external criterion (MEASUREMENT, load-bearing), there is no control arm and the prompt changed mid-series with the claim frozen at v1 (DESIGN, load-bearing). The forge outcome cannot serve as the criterion because it is instrument-dominated (58% -> 2.5% by day) and the stratified test is null. A fair test needs a frozen forge judge, api-state excluded, and a random-triple or non-Nous arm.

disposition.rationale: Chosen over MEASUREMENT_FAILURE because the measurement defect is downstream of a design that had no external criterion and no control arm: even a perfect forge judge could not have said whether Nous's triples beat random ones, since no non-Nous arm was ever run. Chosen over ORCHESTRATION_FAILURE / PRODUCER_BLOCKED / CONSUMER_BLOCKED because the pipeline moved: 95.1% of output was consumed and the forge ran 1212 more keys than the tree records. Chosen over SUPERSEDED_BUT_ORGANS_SALVAGEABLE because supersession (nous_t2) explains why it stopped, not whether it worked. Not TRUE_CORPSE: the hypothesis was never tested. Not optimistic: the record also fails to show Nous doing anything a random-triple generator would not have done.

changed_design: Frankenstein counterfactual, DESIGN ONLY (not authorised to run; this pass ran no LLM calls). A = the March forge stack (Nous -> Hephaestus). Layer Y = DESIGN.

Mutation M1: add a control arm. Arm (i) 300 Nous triples sampled uniformly from committed v2-prompt runs; arm (ii) 300 uniformly random triples from the same 95-dictionary under the same v2 prompt; arm (iii) 300 triples from a non-Nous seed (the remaining T1 gap categories in forge/STATUS_T1_T2_20260403.md).

Mutation M2: external criterion. All 900 forged by ONE frozen Hephaestus judge (single battery version, single code-gen model); api_call_failed rows re-run until resolved or dropped from all arms alike; judge_version and api_state fingerprinted on every ledger row.
C -> C': the self-rating composite stops being the selection criterion and becomes a covariate; arm identity is the only manipulated variable.
descendant_candidate.consumer: Hephaestus forge under a frozen judge (the dossier for Hephaestus must first establish that such a judge exists); results returned to this dossier
descendant_candidate.consumption_proof: Per-arm forge ledger rows with judge_version and api_state fingerprinted; the consumption is the ledger append itself, verified by re-running nous_forge_join.py restricted to the three arm tags.
descendant_candidate.expected_if_alive: Arm (i) forge rate exceeds arm (ii) by more than the permutation-null 97.5th percentile at n=300/arm (nous_forge_join.py auc/perm_null machinery), and the effect survives holding the self-rating composite fixed.
descendant_candidate.expected_if_dead: Arms (i) and (ii) forge at rates inside each other's permutation null; the cross-field sampler adds nothing a uniform sampler lacks under a fixed judge.
descendant_candidate.positive_control: Arm (iii) (gap-targeted seeds) must show a nonzero forge rate under the frozen judge, else the judge, not the seeds, is dead and the run is void.
descendant_candidate.negative_or_decoy_control: A 4th arm of 100 triples with shuffled concept descriptions (names kept, descriptions permuted) to detect prompt-format capture by the judge.
descendant_candidate.kill_condition: Kill before run if no frozen forge judge can be attested (Hephaestus dossier) or if api_call_failed exceeds 10% of any arm after retry; kill after run if the positive control forges 0/300.
descendant_candidate.resource_budget: 900 + 100 LLM hypothesis calls plus 1000 forge code-gen calls; one operator-day; HITL authorisation required for any spend (this pass ran no LLM calls).
